_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.1-05: the SEEKER'S JOURNAL's events. Read by tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_journal.py,
which writes include/constants/hoenn_journal.h (one heard flag per event), src/data/hoenn_journal.h
(the table src/hoenn_journal.c reads), src/data/hoenn_journal_hints.h (which hint lines and rumors
set which heard flag; included by src/hoenn_hints.c) and data/scripts/hoenn_journal_texts.inc.
entries: in page order. key: letters, digits, _ (never rename: its heard flag is saved, see
data/hoenn/journal_flags.json). page: johto / kanto / hoenn (events elsewhere go on the page of
the region you reach them from). hint: the list name once you've heard of it, a question, <= 18
characters. title: the list name once found, <= 18 characters. rumor: what you heard (shown when
you pick a heard entry). found_text: one line in Birch's aide's voice about what you saw.
found: the hint engine's conditions (data/hoenn/npc_hints.json's comment), all must hold.
heard: where you hear of it. rumors: hint rumor keys (any NPC line naming the rumor, or the field
notes reading it out); lines: hint line keys; calls: HOENN_CALL_* IDs; if: conditions, any one
of which counts as heard (things you've seen that point to it, or a scene that sets the heard
flag itself: FLAG_HOENN_HEARD_<KEY>). Found always counts as heard.
A hint line, rumor or call can feed only one entry.
when (2.1-06): the TODAY page's rule. An entry with one shows there when you've heard of it, it isn't
found yet (or repeat: true, an event that comes back), and today fits: days (SUN..SAT; a night-only
event counts the night's weekday, so 1 AM Tuesday is still Monday night) and weather (map folders: one
of them has its special-weather day today). times (morning/day/evening/night), hour and tide (low/high)
only go in its line, built from them unless text is given.
Every later part adds its own entries here (2.1 plan section 15), like the hint-line rule.

entries.title: CHIKORITA's meadow
entries.rumor: A family of CHIKORITA is said to sunbathe in a hidden meadow off ROUTE 46. Follow the sweet smell, by day.
entries.found_text: A MEGANIUM watching over its young in the sun. The meadow smelled like spring the whole time!

entries.title: The tower's embers
entries.rumor: TYPHLOSION are said to bring their young to the BURNED TOWER in ECRUTEAK at night.
entries.found_text: A TYPHLOSION and its CYNDAQUIL, warming the pit of the BURNED TOWER. It still smells of smoke down there.

entries.title: The lake's cove
entries.rumor: Something keeps stealing a fisherman's bait at the LAKE OF RAGE. A FERALIGATR is said to raise its young in the south cove.
entries.found_text: A FERALIGATR and its TOTODILE in the LAKE OF RAGE's south cove. The bait thief was one of them all along!

entries.title: LAPRAS's song
entries.rumor: Every Friday, a LAPRAS is said to sing deep down in UNION CAVE.
entries.found_text: The LAPRAS of UNION CAVE. Its song carried through the whole cave.

entries.title: KIYO's sparring
entries.rumor: The KARATE KING in MT. MORTAR is said to spar with a wild MACHAMP every morning.
entries.found_text: KIYO and the MACHAMP, trading blows at dawn. KIYO says it's the only partner who never holds back.

entries.title: The SCIZOR's duel
entries.rumor: Some evenings, blades clash behind the trees in the NATIONAL PARK's north-east corner. Only on TUESDAYS, THURSDAYS and SATURDAYS.
entries.found_text: A SCIZOR fighting two SCYTHER for the park's corner. It kept its ground.

entries.title: SLOWKING's riddles
entries.rumor: The SLOWKING down SLOWPOKE WELL is said to ask a different riddle every day of the week.
entries.found_text: Seven riddles, seven answers, and then a prophecy about a silver bird and the sea.

entries.title: The Rosetta line
entries.rumor: A new line of writing turned up inside the RUINS OF ALPH, with dots on it like nothing the lab has seen.
entries.found_text: Braille and UNOWN letters on the same line: AT NIGHT WE SPEAK.

entries.title: The night words
entries.rumor: AT NIGHT WE SPEAK… The RUINS' WORDS chambers may say something new after dark, a different word each night.
entries.found_text: A word for every night of the week, glowing in the WORDS chambers. Each one names a place.

entries.title: The UNOWN rings
entries.rumor: Hikers see UNOWN floating in a circle at night, deep in the caves. Always somewhere a night word names.
entries.found_text: Seven rings of UNOWN, seven pieces of an old tablet. Put together, they spell ANCIENT.

entries.title: The UNOWN sanctum
entries.rumor: The tablet's mark points to a boulder south of the RUINS' central chamber. By day it's just a worn boulder.
entries.found_text: Under the boulder, a chamber with a mural of every UNOWN, and an inscription about SINJOH.

entries.title: SNEASEL's hoard
entries.rumor: Items keep vanishing off the ice deep down in the ICE PATH, only at night. CLAIR thinks it's a POKéMON.
entries.found_text: A SNEASEL snatching items off the ICE PATH's ice, three times over. Its hoard was in a nook all along.

entries.title: The hidden lagoon
entries.rumor: Sail past the WHIRL ISLANDS after dark and a light bobs on the water, as if it wants to be followed.
entries.found_text: A LANTURN's light led all the way to a lagoon behind the ridge, with an old stone in it.

entries.title: AMPHAROS rescued
entries.rumor: AMPHY won't settle at night. It stands at the top of the LIGHTHOUSE, watching a second light out at sea.
entries.found_text: A second AMPHAROS, stranded on a sea rock off ROUTE 40. Three berries won it over, and it rode home with you.

entries.title: LUGIA's shrine
entries.rumor: Something huge and silver was seen singing off ROUTE 41, and the lagoon stone has four hollows. Feathers, maybe?
entries.found_text: Three feathers and the SILVER WING in the lagoon stone. The sea flashed white, and LUGIA's song answered.

entries.title: RAIKOU and ENTEI
entries.rumor: The beasts that fled the BURNED TOWER roam all over JOHTO. EUSINE in CELADON wants to hear when you've met them.
entries.found_text: RAIKOU and ENTEI, both met face to face. They never stay anywhere for long.

entries.title: HO-OH at dawn
entries.rumor: The TIN TOWER's sages say HO-OH comes back to the roof at dawn, once every sign is in place.
entries.found_text: HO-OH on the TIN TOWER's roof at sunrise. The whole sky turned the colors of its wings.

entries.title: Forest offerings
entries.rumor: The ILEX FOREST shrine has three empty dishes. Something grown in three forests might fill them.
entries.found_text: Berries grown in ILEX FOREST, VIRIDIAN FOREST and PETALBURG WOODS, set before the shrine.

entries.title: The moon hollow
entries.rumor: TEDDIURSA are said to come for honey spread on an old pine at the bottom of ROUTE 45.
entries.found_text: The URSARING mother led you up the cliff at night, to a hollow where the bears watch the moon.

entries.title: DUNSPARCE's burrow
entries.rumor: DARK CAVE's holes are said to move with the time of day. Something keeps digging down there.
entries.found_text: A DUNSPARCE that dug and dug until it had three segments. The burrow goes deeper every visit.

when.text: Its hole moves with the time of day.

entries.title: RAYQUAZA at noon
entries.rumor: SKY PILLAR's mural shows a green orb. Set into the right tower at noon, it might call the sky's guardian down.
entries.found_text: RAYQUAZA, coiled around the EMBEDDED TOWER at high noon.

entries.title: The REGI doors
entries.rumor: Up at the SINJOH RUINS, boulders seal the caves in the cliffs, carved with braille older than any we know.
entries.found_text: All three boulders rolled aside. Something big stirred behind each one.

entries.title: The daily swarm
entries.rumor: Every day, one kind of POKéMON swarms on one route, in JOHTO, KANTO or HOENN. The TV news and PROF. OAK's show on the radio say where.
entries.found_text: A whole route full of one kind of POKéMON! A different one swarms every day, and some are found nowhere else.

entries.title: BULBASAUR's garden
entries.rumor: BILL's grandpa says BULBASAUR meet in a garden behind his house. In the morning, slip through the trees above the cape.
entries.found_text: A whole garden of BULBASAUR, and three of them blooming into IVYSAUR at once.

entries.title: CHARMANDER's wait
entries.rumor: The CERULEAN NURSE saw a CHARMANDER by NUGGET BRIDGE at dusk, waiting in the rain.
entries.found_text: A CHARMANDER still waiting for the trainer who left it. It has a new trainer now.

entries.title: The SQUIRTLE SQUAD
entries.rumor: A gang of SQUIRTLE plays by ROUTE 6's pond, mornings and days. Their leader wears sunglasses!
entries.found_text: The SQUIRTLE SQUAD's pitfall, their hideout, and a night fire in VERMILION that they put out.

entries.title: The shadow chase
entries.rumor: On some nights in LAVENDER TOWN, people swear their own shadows grin at them. Follow where it points.
entries.found_text: A GENGAR hiding in your shadow, from LAVENDER all the way to the RADIO TOWER.

entries.title: ZAPDOS's roost
entries.rumor: When a thunderstorm hits ROUTE 10, lightning strikes the POWER PLANT. The MANAGER keeps what it leaves behind.
entries.found_text: ZAPDOS came down to its roost on ROUTE 10 when the THUNDER FEATHER called it.

when.text: Thunderstorm day at ROUTE 10's POWER PLANT.

entries.title: ARTICUNO's roost
entries.rumor: BILL says each of the three birds has a roost. ARTICUNO's is deep in the SEAFOAM ISLANDS, and a FROST FEATHER might call it.
entries.found_text: ARTICUNO landed in the SEAFOAM ISLANDS, drawn down by the FROST FEATHER.

entries.title: MOLTRES's roost
entries.rumor: BILL says MOLTRES roosts high up on MT. SILVER. A FLAME FEATHER might bring it down.
entries.found_text: MOLTRES came back to its roost on MT. SILVER for the FLAME FEATHER.

entries.title: The ONIX bore
entries.rumor: A different hole opens in ROCK TUNNEL every night, and the ground rumbles once. Something huge is boring through the rock.
entries.found_text: A shining ONIX, deep in the tunnels it bores. It moves its hole every night.

entries.title: TANGELA's islet
entries.rumor: On ROUTE 21's little islet, the vines move aside in the morning. Something is hiding in them.
entries.found_text: A TANGELA living in the vines on ROUTE 21's islet.

entries.title: The lost baby
entries.rumor: Evenings, something small cries on the SAFARI ZONE's BEACH. And a KANGASKHAN mother paces with an empty pouch.
entries.found_text: A baby KANGASKHAN, walked all the way back to its mother's pouch.

entries.title: TAUROS stampede
entries.rumor: Monday mornings, a herd of TAUROS charges back and forth up in the SAFARI ZONE's highland.
entries.found_text: Through the stampede to the lead bull, a TAUROS from far-off PALDEA.

entries.title: The SEAFOAM titans
entries.rumor: Some days the fog over the SEAFOAM waters is thick as soup. The right ORB is said to turn it into a storm, or a drought.
entries.found_text: KYOGRE and GROUDON, asleep under the SEAFOAM ISLANDS, woken by the ORBS.

when.text: Fog day on the SEAFOAM waters.

entries.title: The ENIGMA STONE
entries.rumor: Red and blue sparkles in SOUTHERN ISLAND's grass, warm like embers. The PEWTER MUSEUM would know what they are.
entries.found_text: Three shards joined into the ENIGMA STONE. SOUTHERN ISLAND's other guardian answers to it.

entries.title: FUJI's journal
entries.rumor: Pages of the burned MANSION's journal keep turning up all over KANTO. They're signed FUJI.
entries.found_text: Six pages of MR. FUJI's journal, and the POKéMON they were about, in CERULEAN's deepest cave.

entries.title: The pink blur
entries.rumor: Something pink zips through the grass at first light, on ROUTE 1, ROUTE 22, even HOENN's ROUTE 101!
entries.found_text: A MEW at dawn, gone before you could look twice. It left a scrap of an old sea map behind.

entries.title: The white rock
entries.rumor: Three wishes on three falling stars, and the white rock at MT. MOON is said to answer, on the night the CLEFAIRY dance.
entries.found_text: JIRACHI, woken by three wishes, landing in MT. MOON's pond.

entries.title: The MUDKIP pond
entries.rumor: Every morning, a SWAMPERT brings two MUDKIP to a pond on ROUTE 102 to practice. When they all dive, rain is coming.
entries.found_text: A SWAMPERT teaching its MUDKIP to dive. The rain came right after, just like they said.

entries.title: The RALTS's trust
entries.rumor: Every morning, a GARDEVOIR guards a RALTS by the tall grass near PETALBURG. Run up to them and they vanish!
entries.found_text: Three slow, quiet mornings, and the RALTS chose to come along.

entries.title: The ash grotto
entries.rumor: A MUNCHLAX has been asleep in the trees by ROUTE 113's first ash fields for weeks. The glassblower might know a tune.
entries.found_text: The GLASS FLUTE woke the MUNCHLAX, and the gap it slept in led to a grotto under the ash.

entries.title: SPINDA's dance
entries.rumor: Some mornings a SPINDA dances in the ash on ROUTE 113, up by the sign. Only once a week!
entries.found_text: A SPINDA dancing in the ash. Every step was different.

entries.title: SLAKING's clearing
entries.rumor: A SLAKING sleeps in a gap in PETALBURG WOODS' trees. It only ever gets up at noon.
entries.found_text: The SLAKING woke at noon, and behind it was NORMAN's old training clearing.

entries.title: TROPIUS orchard
entries.rumor: TROPIUS shakes fruit off its neck when the sun comes up. One was seen flying into the trees under the FORTREE sign.
entries.found_text: A hidden orchard behind a tree trunk on ROUTE 119, with a TROPIUS and a tree full of fruit.

entries.title: The mirror pool
entries.rumor: Nobody looks twice at the fish in a little pond up ROUTE 119. It's said to bite only after dark.
entries.found_text: A FEEBAS in the mirror pool. Its scales shine like a prism if you look closely.

entries.title: The island feud
entries.rumor: Every Sunday night, on the same island in ROUTE 114's lake, ZANGOOSE and SEVIPER have the same fight.
entries.found_text: ZANGOOSE and SEVIPER, mid-fight on the island. They turned on you together!

entries.title: ABSOL on the ridge
entries.rumor: A white POKéMON stands on ROUTE 120's ridge when the storm rolls in.
entries.found_text: ABSOL on the ridge in the storm. It only roams ROUTE 120 on stormy nights.

when.text: Storm day on ROUTE 120! In the evening or at night.

entries.title: The atoll
entries.rumor: A WAILORD sleeps in the rocks off ROUTE 131. It's always listening for something.
entries.found_text: The WAILORD woke and swam off, and the strait it blocked led to a ring of sand around a lagoon.

entries.title: MT. PYRE's chimes
entries.rumor: On still nights, the chimes at MT. PYRE's summit ring by themselves.
entries.found_text: A CHIMECHO, ringing between the graves. The sound led right to it.

entries.title: The ALTARIA chorus
entries.rumor: Saturday mornings, singing comes from the top of METEOR FALLS. ALTARIA, surely.
entries.found_text: A whole chorus of ALTARIA on the clifftop, and one of them shone a different color.

entries.title: BAGON's leap
entries.rumor: A BAGON lives deep in METEOR FALLS. Every morning it jumps off a ledge, trying to fly.
entries.found_text: The BAGON's leap, again and again. It hasn't flown yet, but it never gives up.

entries.title: The METAGROSS
entries.rumor: Once a week, the meteorite pieces in STEVEN's cave at METEOR FALLS are said to glow at night.
entries.found_text: Two METANG fused into a METAGROSS in STEVEN's cave, in a flash of white.

entries.title: The desert's song
entries.rumor: The desert on ROUTE 111 sings at sunset: a low hum rolls over the dunes, only in the evening.
entries.found_text: A TRAPINCH's tracks, a hollow where the sand drains, and a VIBRAVA that gave you its SINGING SAND.

entries.title: The MIRAGE TOWER
entries.rumor: A FLYGON is said to have sung at the top of the MIRAGE TOWER, long ago. A chime of desert sand might raise it again.
entries.found_text: The SAND CHIME raised the MIRAGE TOWER, and FLYGON was waiting at the top.

entries.title: The trench
entries.rumor: After dark, the deep water off ROUTE 124 glows. A CHINCHOU's light waits on the seabed.
entries.found_text: The CHINCHOU lights led to a crack in the seabed, and a trench black as ink.

entries.title: The mound's door
entries.rumor: Something different guards the bottom of ROUTE 124's trench each day: HUNTAIL, GOREBYSS or RELICANTH.
entries.found_text: All three guardians met, and the mound at the bottom of the trench opened.

entries.title: The ice chamber
entries.rumor: When the tide goes out, a hole is said to open in SHOAL CAVE's ice room.
entries.found_text: Down the hole at low tide, a sliding-ice chamber, and a GLALIE on a frozen pool.

when.text: Any time but night, at low tide.

entries.title: The pillar chase
entries.rumor: Something cold walks the ice chamber at night when the tide is out. You see her in the ice before you see her.
entries.found_text: A FROSLASS hiding from pillar to pillar, and a FROST FEATHER frozen behind her.

entries.title: CASTFORM
entries.rumor: CASTFORM only show themselves when the weather turns, around ROUTES 119, 120 and 123.
entries.found_text: A CASTFORM, riding the weather near the WEATHER INSTITUTE.

when.text: The weather turns on ROUTE 119, 120 or 123 today.

entries.title: MASQUERAIN
entries.rumor: In HOENN, MASQUERAIN are said to flutter out of the grass only on rainy days.
entries.found_text: A MASQUERAIN, out in the rain. It only comes when the sky opens.

when.text: Rain is due on a HOENN route today.

entries.title: The flyover
entries.rumor: A burning shadow sometimes sweeps over the ash on ROUTE 113. The ash goes warm right before it comes!
entries.found_text: MOLTRES, sweeping low over ROUTE 113. It dropped a FLAME FEATHER in the ash.

entries.title: The space signal
entries.rumor: MOSSDEEP's SPACE CENTER is picking up a signal from space, only at night.
entries.found_text: The signal, logged night after night. It came with a ticket to a far island.
